Faq.title: Questions before we start
Faq.intro: Clear answers for e-commerce brands planning UGC, AI commercials or product content.

turnaround.question: What is the typical turnaround time?
turnaround.answer: <hl>One video</hl>: usually 3–5 business days after the creative direction and required input have been approved. <hl>Content Duo</hl>: usually 5–8 business days, depending on complexity and feedback. <hl>Brand Partner</hl>: planning is agreed per month. At the start, we agree together on a fixed content schedule and delivery moments. Turnaround times are indicative and can vary depending on feedback, complexity and available assets.

product.question: Will the AI video match my physical product?
product.answer: I work from your real product images and oversee brand alignment and colour grading, so the final result matches the creative direction agreed upfront.

ads.question: Can I use the content in ads?
ads.answer: Usage rights are agreed clearly per project. Use on your own channels can be part of the package. Paid advertising, whitelisting or broader commercial use may require additional agreements.

revisions.question: How do revisions and delivery work?
revisions.answer: Every package includes two revision rounds per video. I guide the project from the first brief through sound design and final export. I deliver content in the format and resolution that suit the platform and project. 4K can be agreed when the source material and production allow it.

payment.question: How do payment and onboarding work?
payment.answer: A <hl>50% deposit</hl> is paid at the start. The remaining amount is paid before or at final delivery, according to the agreed project terms.

meta.description: Authentic UGC videos for e-commerce brands, social media and paid ads. From concept to platform-ready content for Instagram, TikTok and Meta.

hero.title: UGC content for e-commerce brands
hero.intro: Authentic videos that show your product being used the way a real customer would. Made for Instagram, TikTok, Meta Ads and your product pages — from concept to a platform-ready file.

context.title: What is UGC?
context.body1: UGC stands for user-generated content: videos that look and sound as if a customer made them. Not a polished ad, but someone unboxing your product, using it and explaining why they like it.
context.body2: For brands, good UGC is no longer left to chance. I create it as a commissioned creator, with a clear concept, a strong first second and a structure that suits the platform the video will run on.

items.one: Webshops that want livelier product pages with relatable, real-use footage
items.two: Brands advertising on Meta and TikTok that regularly need fresh creatives
items.three: New products that need to build trust with an audience that doesn’t know the brand yet
items.four: Teams without the time or budget for a full video shoot

one.title: Trust
one.body: People see your product in a familiar situation, which feels closer than a traditional ad.

two.title: Organic social
two.body: UGC sits naturally in Instagram and TikTok feeds, so it feels less like advertising.

three.title: Meta Ads & TikTok
three.body: For paid social I build videos around a clear hook, so you can compare different angles side by side.

four.title: Product storytelling
four.body: A good UGC video tells a small story: the problem, the moment of use and what the product solves.

examples.title: Examples
examples.intro: A selection of my UGC work: product videos I filmed myself. Independent concepts are labelled as such.
examples.social: See earlier UGC content on TikTok

one.title: Product & brief
one.body: You tell me about your product, your audience and where the video will be used.

two.title: Concept & approval
two.body: I write opening lines and a structure. You approve the direction before production begins.

three.title: Production
three.body: I film the video with your product and edit it, including sound and colour.

four.title: Delivery
four.body: You receive platform-ready files, with revision rounds as included in your package.

pricing.title: What does UGC cost?
pricing.body: UGC is part of my content packages. For each video we decide together whether UGC, AI or a mix works best.

one.q: What’s the difference between UGC and an AI commercial?
one.a: UGC is built around a real person and a relatable moment of use. An AI commercial is a cinematic product video made without a traditional shoot. I look at what suits each concept — sometimes a combination works best.

two.q: Which platforms do you create UGC for?
two.a: Instagram and Reels, TikTok, Meta Ads, organic social and your webshop. You receive each video in the format of the platform it will run on.

three.q: How many revision rounds are included?
three.a: Every content package includes two revision rounds per video.

hero.title: AI commercials for e-commerce brands
hero.intro: Cinematic product videos without a film set, crew or location. I develop the concept, protect the look of your product and deliver a finished commercial for Meta, TikTok, Reels and your webshop.

context.title: What is an AI commercial?
context.body1: An AI commercial is a product video whose shots are generated and directed with AI, then edited professionally. It lets you show sets, moods and camera moves that would be expensive or impossible on a traditional shoot.
context.body2: AI is a tool here, not a replacement for creative decisions. The difference is in the direction: a clear concept, a consistent look and a finish with sound design and colour grading.

items.one: E-commerce brands that want a premium look without an agency-sized production budget
items.two: Brands with a launch or campaign that need visuals quickly
items.three: Advertisers who want to try several visual directions on Meta and TikTok
items.four: Webshops that want to add motion to their product pages

benefits.title: What an AI commercial gives you

one.title: Creative direction
one.body: Every video starts with a concept and a visual direction that fits your brand — not a random prompt.

two.title: Product consistency
two.body: Your product has to stay recognisable. I work from your own product images and check shape, colour and detail at every stage.

three.title: Storyboard first
three.body: Before production starts you see how the video is built, so there are no surprises afterwards.

four.title: Formats per platform
four.body: Vertical for Reels and TikTok, other ratios for feed or webshop — matched to where the video runs.

two.body: Hooks, scenes and visual style in a storyboard, approved before production begins.

three.title: Production
three.body: AI production of the shots with checks on product details, followed by editing, sound design and colour grading.

four.title: Delivery
four.body: Delivered in the formats you need, with revision rounds as included in your package.

pricing.body: AI commercials use the same content packages as UGC. The price depends on the number of videos, not on the technique.

context.body1: Product content is every visual you use to sell a product: short product videos, lifestyle shots, detail shots and visuals for product pages, carousels and ads.

pricing.title: Pricing for product content
pricing.body: For video you work with the content packages. For standalone AI product images there are photo packages.

one.q: Product video or product photos — what do I need?
one.a: Video shows how a product works and feels; images are quicker to scan on a product page or in a carousel. Many brands use both: photos for the webshop, short videos for social and ads.

two.q: Can I combine UGC and AI?
two.a: Yes. A hybrid approach combines human content with AI visuals, product shots and motion. Together, we decide on the right mix based on your product and platform.

three.a: For one product or a first collaboration, the One video package is a logical start. If you want to test several hooks or directions, Content Duo fits. For ongoing content there’s Brand Partner, and for standalone product images there are photo packages.

meta.title: How I Work: From Idea to Delivery | Monika Mal
meta.description: How I work in four steps: product & brief, concept & approval, production and delivery. With indicative timelines, revisions and formats.

HowItWorks.title: From first idea to platform-ready content
HowItWorks.intro: A clear four-step process. You know upfront what you’ll get, when you give feedback and what I need from you.

intro.title: Product & brief
intro.body: You tell me about your product, brand, audience and where the content will be used. A product name, link or short explanation is enough to get started.

concept.title: Concept & approval
concept.body: I develop the creative direction: hooks, storytelling, visual style and, where useful, a storyboard or moodboard. You approve the direction before production begins.

production.title: Production
production.body: Depending on the concept, I create UGC, AI content or a combination of both, followed by editing, sound design, colour finishing and final production.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.body: You receive platform-ready files in the agreed formats. Any revision rounds are completed according to the selected package.

timeline.title: Indicative timelines

items.starter: Usually 3–5 business days after the creative direction and required input have been approved.
items.growth: Usually 5–8 business days, depending on complexity and feedback.
items.partnership: Planned per month, with a fixed content schedule and delivery moments agreed at the start.

timeline.note: Timelines are indicative and can vary depending on feedback, complexity and available assets.

revisions.title: Revisions
revisions.body: Every content package includes two revision rounds per video. The free demo is one concept without revision rounds, meant as a preview and not for commercial use.

items.product: Your product name or a link to your product or webshop
items.platform: Where the content will run: Reels, TikTok, Meta Ads or your webshop
items.brand: Any brand guidelines, logos or product photos
items.deadline: A preferred deadline or launch date

formats.title: Formats
formats.body1: I deliver content in the format and resolution that suit the platform and project — usually vertical 9:16 for Reels and TikTok, and other ratios for feed or webshop where needed.
formats.body2: 4K can be agreed when the source material and production allow it.
